card.name: Stray separators and zero-width spaces
card.fires_on: Invisible zero-width spaces or separator marks (bars, bullets, dashes) that sit between phrases, often right before a comma or in a list or table.

modes.label: Zero-width space in warnings
modes.description: An invisible space character after a clause in label warning text, just before a comma.
modes.example: If symptoms persist or worsen<< ​>>, seek advice of licensed health care practitioner

modes.label: Table or menu dividers
modes.description: A pipe, bullet, or dash used as a divider in tables, menus, or dictionary entries.

card.plain: It fires on odd divider marks and hidden spaces that separate pieces of text, not on any medical word.
